f.value: Animal group record:	aAnimal:	type	aNumber:	group size	aPosition:	position at stop  --expect unused	aisDecoy:	decoy flagaNames:	type names.-------------------------The groups may be in a train car, orthey may be at a train stop.At the stop there may be decoys, which areanimals that are never target ani mals,but no decoys are currently being used.A group record is formed by the ith element of thelists.These records correspond to the available assets.aNames: animal names.  The animal type is an index into the names array.aAnimals: The animal type.  All pigs have the same type, for example, independent of group size or being a decoy.aNumbers: the size of the group.aPositions: the position of the group at the stop: 1 | 2 | 3aisDecoy: is the group a decoy.
TRAIN_SIZE:	used to initialize the train (cars).aCars:	car values are animal group records.
N_STOPS:	number of stopsaDecoys:	decoy groups at stop.  Decoy groups are in                 addition to the group that will get on the                train.
